thread.title: Qualcomm stock falls as Trump's blockage of buyout leaves it vulnerable, analyst says - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Qualcomm stock falls as Trump's blockage of buyout leaves it vulnerable, analyst says - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Qualcomm Inc. QCOM, -4.20% are down 3.8% in Tuesday morning trading, after President Donald Trump said that he would block Broadcom Ltd.'s AVGO, +2.25% hostile takeover of the company. Broadcom shares are up 2.6% and Intel Corp. INTC, +2.78% shares are up 3.2%. "With the takeover risk gone, Qualcomm must face the reality of multiple outstanding issues, including its own acquisition of NXP Semiconductors NXPI, -0.01% a major conflict with Apple AAPL, +0.55% and headwinds in its core businesses," BMO Capital Markets analyst Tim Long wrote Tuesday. Qualcomm shares are up 3.5% over the past 12 months, while Broadcom shares are up 19%. The S&P 500 SPX, +0.18% has gained 18% in that time, while the PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX, +0.47% is up 45%.
